title: FlowDoc WYSIWYG Gate Decision
summary: Record a Project Control-owned WYSIWYG Gate Decision v1 that keeps the gate closed, preserves existing bounded authoring evidence, defines managed editable cards and bounded text islands, blocks broad contenteditable and rich editor shortcuts, and names prerequisites for later product lanes.
expectedOutput: WYSIWYG Gate Decision v1 in Project Control, with accepted closed-gate definition, allowed managed editable cards and bounded text islands, blocked contenteditable shortcuts and rich editor package adoption, prerequisites, stop conditions, and no product repository implementation.
riskSummary: The WYSIWYG decision may be mistaken for readiness or direct editing permission. Hidden contenteditable shortcuts, broad contenteditable shortcuts, rich editor package adoption, direct preview typing, table/cell surface editing, media surface editing, publish behavior, production behavior, compatibility, FlowDoc product truth, and map truth remain blocked or unknown until later evidence-backed lanes.
